name: National Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: Unified 24/7 all-in-one emergency helpline for Police, Fire, Ambulance, and Disaster assistance across India.
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Government of India

name: Women Helpline (WHL) - Mission Shakti
description: 24/7 toll-free emergency and crisis intervention for women affected by violence, harassment, or domestic abuse; linked to One Stop Centres (OSCs).
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), Government of India

name: National Cyber Financial Fraud Helpline
description: Immediate reporting of unauthorized online banking fraud, UPI scams, and digital financial theft to freeze stolen funds in transit.
authority: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs

name: National Legal Aid Toll-Free Helpline (NALSA)
description: Official 24/7 free legal assistance helpline connecting citizens to DLSA legal aid defense counsels and Lok Adalat services.
authority: National Legal Services Authority, Ministry of Law & Justice

name: Women Power Line (WPL 1090) - UP Police
description: Dedicated women protection cell against stalking, vulgar phone calls, eve-teasing, and cyber harassment. State-specific to Uttar Pradesh.
authority: Uttar Pradesh Police, Government of Uttar Pradesh

name: State Police Women Helpline
description: Direct police response unit for women in distress. Active in Delhi (011-23317004), Tamil Nadu, Haryana, and Karnataka.

name: Childline 1098 (Child Emergency)
description: Emergency outreach service for children in need of care and protection, integrated under the ERSS 112 platform.
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
